auth.description:
To obtain your OAuth2 credentials:

    1. Go to Wrike (https://www.wrike.com/)
    2. Sign in to your account or create one
    3. Go to Apps & Integrations (https://www.wrike.com/apps/)
    4. Click "Create new app" or use an existing one
    5. For local development, add `http://localhost:4200/redirect` to the allowed redirect URIs
    6. For production, add `https://cloud.activepieces.com/redirect` to the allowed redirect URIs
    7. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret

create_task.name: create_task
create_task.description: Create a new task in Wrike

folderId.description: The ID of the folder where the task will be created

assignees.description: User IDs to assign to the task

customFields.description: Custom field values for the task

aiMetadata.description: Create a task inside a specific Wrike folder, with optional status, importance, assignees (user IDs), start/due dates, duration, and custom fields. Use when an agent needs to add work items to a Wrike project or folder. Requires the target folder ID; each call creates a distinct task, so it is not idempotent.

update_task.name: update_task
update_task.description: Update fields of an existing task in Wrike

taskId.description: The ID of the task to update

title.description: The new title of the task

description.description: The new description of the task

status.description: The new status of the task

importance.description: The new importance/priority of the task

assignees.description: User IDs to assign to the task (replaces existing assignees)

customFields.description: Custom field values to update for the task

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing Wrike task identified by its task ID, setting only the provided fields (title, description, status, importance, assignees, dates, duration, custom fields); supplied assignees replace the existing ones. Use when an agent needs to modify a known task rather than create one. Requires the task ID; re-running with the same input leaves the task in the same state, so it is idempotent.

create_folder.name: create_folder
create_folder.description: Create a new folder in Wrike

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder where the new folder will be created. Leave empty to create at root level.

shareds.description: User IDs to share the folder with

project.description: Whether this folder should be created as a project with additional project settings

projectOwnerId.description: The ID of the user who will own the project (required when creating as project)

projectStartDate.description: The start date of the project (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

projectEndDate.description: The end date of the project (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

aiMetadata.description: Create a folder in Wrike, either at root level or nested under a parent folder ID; enabling the project option turns it into a project with owner and start/end dates instead of a plain folder. Use when an agent needs to set up a new container for tasks. Each call creates a new folder, so it is not idempotent.

create_project.name: create_project
create_project.description: Create a new project in Wrike

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder where the project will be created. Leave empty to create at root level.

ownerIds.description: User IDs who will own the project

shareds.description: User IDs to share the project with

aiMetadata.description: Create a project in Wrike (a folder configured as a project) at root level or under a parent folder ID, with optional owners, shared users, and start/end dates. Use when an agent needs a project container rather than a plain folder. Each call creates a new project, so it is not idempotent.

add_comment.name: add_comment
add_comment.description: Add a comment or internal note to a task or folder

entityType.description: Select whether you want to add the comment to a task or folder

entityId.description: The ID of the task or folder to add the comment to

text.description: The text content of the comment

plainText.description: Whether the comment should be treated as plain text (no HTML formatting). Default is HTML formatting.

aiMetadata.description: Post a comment on a Wrike task or folder, selected via the entity type and entity ID; the comment text can be HTML or plain text. Use when an agent needs to annotate or leave a note on an item. Each call appends a new comment, so it is not idempotent.

upload_attachment.name: upload_attachment
upload_attachment.description: Upload a file and attach it to a task or folder

entityType.description: Select whether to attach the file to a task or folder

entityId.description: The ID of the task or folder to attach the file to

file.description: The file to upload and attach

fileName.description: Optional custom name for the uploaded file

aiMetadata.description: Upload a file and attach it to a Wrike task or folder, chosen via the entity type and entity ID, with an optional custom file name. Use when an agent needs to add a document or asset to an item. Each call uploads a new attachment, so it is not idempotent.

find_task.name: find_task
find_task.description: Retrieve a task by its ID or lookup fields

taskId.description: The ID of the task to retrieve. If provided, other search criteria will be ignored.

title.description: Search for tasks by title (partial match)

folderId.description: Search for tasks within a specific folder

assignees.description: Filter tasks by assignee user IDs

authors.description: Filter tasks by author user IDs

pageSize.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (max 1000)

aiMetadata.description: Look up Wrike tasks: pass a task ID to fetch that exact task (other criteria are ignored), or omit it to search/filter by title, folder, status, importance, assignees, or authors with sorting and page size. Use when an agent needs to find or read tasks before acting on them. Read-only and idempotent.

find_folder.name: find_folder
find_folder.description: Retrieve folder / project metadata by ID or name

folderId.description: The ID of the folder/project to retrieve. If provided, other search criteria will be ignored.

title.description: Search for folders/projects by title (partial match)

parentIds.description: Search for folders/projects within specific parent folders

project.description: Filter to only return projects (folders marked as projects)

pageSize.description: Maximum number of folders/projects to return (max 1000)

authors.description: Filter by authors (users who created the folders)

owners.description: Filter by owners (users who own the projects)

aiMetadata.description: Look up Wrike folders or projects: pass a folder ID to fetch that exact one (other criteria are ignored), or omit it to search/filter by title, parent folders, authors, owners, or the projects-only flag. Use when an agent needs to resolve or read folder/project metadata before acting. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

new_task.name: new_task
new_task.description: Fires when a new task is created in Wrike (optionally within a folder).

folderId.description: Optional: Only trigger for tasks created in this specific folder

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new task is created in Wrike, registered via a webhook on the TaskCreated event; can be scoped to a single folder so it only fires for tasks created there.

new_folder.description: Fires when a new folder (or project) is created in Wrike.

parentFolderId.description: Optional: Only trigger for folders created in this specific parent folder

new_subtask_created.name: new_subtask_created
new_subtask_created.description: Triggers when a subtask is created.

parentTaskId.description: Optional: Only trigger for subtasks created under this specific parent task

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a task gains a parent in Wrike (the TaskParentsAdded event), representing a subtask being created under another task; can be scoped to a single parent task so it only fires for subtasks added beneath it.

    2. Sign in to your account or create one
    3. Go to Apps & Integrations (https://www.wrike.com/apps/)
    4. Click "Create new app" or use an existing one

    6. For production, add `https://cloud.activepieces.com/redirect` to the allowed redirect URIs
    7. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret
